## Summary

What problem does this change address, and what is the resulting behavior or
project-state change?

## Scope and authority

List the important specification, design, documentation, or implementation
constraints that govern this change. Write `N/A` when genuinely not applicable.

## Validation

List the exact focused/static/full checks that were run and their results. Do
not describe skipped validation as passing validation.

## Review

Describe meaningful review performed for substantive changes, including any
independent review context when applicable.

## AI assistance

Choose or describe the closest fit:

- [ ] none or incidental
- [ ] substantial
- [ ] fully generated
- [ ] other / explained below

Prompts, transcripts, token counts, and model-by-model logs are not required.

## Known limitations or deferred work

List anything deliberately left out, or write `None`.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the applicable `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I checked the current repository state rather than relying on an old SHA or historical behavior.
- [ ] I kept unrelated changes out of this pull request.
- [ ] I added or updated validation evidence appropriate to the change.
- [ ] I updated documentation/specification owners when the change requires it.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute the submitted material.
